SELECT d.nom_est AS "Nombre", round(st_distance (ST_GeomFromText(#{point},900913),d.the_geom )::numeric,0) AS "Distancia", d.transporte AS "Transporte", d.desc_cort AS "Establecimiento", nomvial AS "Calle", d.numextnum||' '||numextalf AS "Núm", d.nomasen AS "Colonia", d.nom_mun AS "Delegacion", d.tel_1 AS "Telefono", d.dir_elec_1 AS "Correo", d.cve_scian AS "cve_scian", ST_AsText(d.the_geom) AS geom FROM ovie_web.denue d
, ovie_web.areas a
WHERE d.cve_scian::numeric in
#{cvescian}
WHERE d.cve_scian::numeric=#{type}
AND a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom)
ORDER BY st_distance(d.the_geom,ST_GeomFromText(#{point},900913)), d.d_llave
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas_pal p,ovie_web.cadenas_productivas c,ovie_web.denue d
, ovie_web.areas a
WHERE p.clv_act=c.clv_act AND c.clave=d.cve_scian::numeric AND p.clv_neg=#{type}
AND a.gid=#{id} AND ST_Intersects(a.the_geom,d.the_geom)
SELECT clv_act AS id, desc_cort AS desc_corto, tipo as type FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas_pal ORDER BY desc_cort
SELECT scian AS id, desc_cort AS desc_corto FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas WHERE clv_act=#{id} ORDER BY orden
SELECT scian AS id FROM ovie_web.cadenas_productivas WHERE clv_act=#{id} ORDER BY orden
